spanish: En mi quebrar a ustedes vara de pan, y cocerán diez mujeres su pan en un horno, y devolverán su pan en peso, y comerán, y no se saciarán.

findings.issue: The 2mp suffix on both “bread” tokens is ustedes-possession, but “su pan” after “diez mujeres” can be read as the women’s bread.
“comerán” and “se saciarán” are licensed ustedes forms for the 2mp verbs, but with no stated subject they can continue the 3rd-person “diez mujeres.”

notes: Break, staff-of-bread, ten women, one oven, hiphil return, weight, eat, and not-be-sated stay inside the tokens.
